These pads have kept my skin very firm. Can't live without them.

I love these pads! I use them at night and swipe across my face, but then I place it on my forehead to soak in that area while I brush my teeth. My forehead looks more plump and my lines are improving. This is a great, easy to use product.
This not only hydrated my skin but has erased fine lines and soften wrinkles.
Highly moisturizing, one of my favorites of the toner pads. Useful for midday refreshing too.
I've been using these nightly, and they have noticeably lowered the appearance of wrinkles on my forehead!

avis.texte: I just loved it , it make my skin so smooth and soft . It was a great purchase

avis.titre: My skin seems to like it
avis.texte: Only been using for less than 2wks, but so far so good. I have super sensitive skin that has a hard time accepting almost any products. I put it on at night followed by Beekman 1802 Collagen Booster Electric Daisy & Peptide Firming Serum.

I recently stumbled upon Mediheal, instantly fell in love. It feels like I've unlocked a secret! I love the sun and have never been one to use sunscreen. I know, I know! I can be somewhat lazy with my evening skincare routine, but I never skip using the Mediheal pads-probably because they're so easy to use and very effective. I apply them in the morning after my shower, before using my other skincare products. Sometimes, I'll use them twice daily. One pad covers my entire face, neck, and chest. They are very moist, so I recommend letting your face dry before applying serums, moisturizers, and sunscreen. Once I've used the pad all over, I go back for my under-eye area and eyelids after the pad isn't too wet. DO NOT be a dummy like me & use a fresh & really wet pad on your eyelids and under-eye area, or you'll end up with it in your eyes and be hit with instant regret! Sometimes, I speed up the drying process with my hairdryer if I'm in a hurry. These pads don't leave a greasy residue on your skin; in fact, they provide an instant glass skin effect, making your makeup go on smoother. Once I hit my late 40's, my skin transitioned from oily-combo to combo-dry in some areas and began experiencing terrible acne. I also developed dermatitis around my mouth from a steroid inhaler I've used for years, which left me with really dry, flaky skin near my smile lines as it healed. As I've aged, I noticed I was getting deeper lines on my forehead, noticeable upper lip wrinkles—which nobody

First of all, there's absolutely no irritation, and it's great for calming redness and heated skin! Above all, my skin feels plump and bouncy the next day! I've been using this for about 2 years now, and I have no complaints at all! Highly recommended! I have redness, so I apply it after washing my face in the evening! Since I have super sensitive skin, I only use it as a mask!
The texture is delightfully bouncy and incredibly hydrating. I'm definitely considering repurchasing, and I think it would work well for combination dehydrated skin. None whatsoever!

avis.titre: I love that the pads are...
avis.texte: I love that the pads are square­shaped. They feel nice and substantial. It also helps reduce facial heat and redness. My sensitive skin gets itchy if I use it two days in a row... That's the only downside though.

Normally, using pads incorrectly can unnecessarily remove the stratum corneum, causing the skin to become overly sensitive. However, this pad is thin and can be applied to the face as a pad pack, and I used it well. Since the pad is extremely thin, I have not been able to use face masks well since my skin became sensitive, but I used it well in the morning to reduce the heat sensation! The essence was also absorbed into the pad more generously than expected, so it did not dry out quickly. The pad material is closer to gauze than cotton, but it was surprisingly soft when wiping the face, and the skin texture was well­maintained by gently wiping. The amount was also plentiful, so I had to use it quite a bit before it was used up. The clamps were too loose, so at first the lid would always fall off when I tried to clip it on. But if I really jammed the end part in as tightly as possible, it would stay on a bit better. However, even when using the clamps, I still had trouble picking up the pages one by one.

The Hwahae Testers' favorite product,, After wiping your skin with this a few times, your skin will feel supple and your makeup won't flake off when applying. It fit well and there were few regrets, but the moistness was slightly lacking, which was the only disappointment.

avis.titre: This is the life pad that I've...
avis.texte: This is the life pad that I've been using for my second headache already! My skin type is close to dry and combination, so the pad is essential in my basic routine. I've tried various famous products, but this is the one that suits me the best. After leaving it on for about 15 minutes, I feel like I've absorbed the collagen nicely and plumpily. It's great to use on its own, and also works well when combined with additional ampoules and serums! Unlike when it was first opened, the moisture gradually decreases the more it is used. As with all pad products, there are similar drawbacks, but the advantages are so pronounced that I continue to purchase and use it regularly :)

avis.titre: I've been using this daily for...
avis.texte: I've been using this daily for a while now. While I've almost used up the entire bottle, among the pads I've tried, this one is the least drying, and the ampoule remains nicely moisturizing. As I've entered my late 20s, I've become quite concerned about skin elasticity, so I picked this product. I'm not sure if it provides a dramatic collagen boost, but it has been gentle on my sensitive skin and I was able to purchase it at a discounted price during a sale, allowing me to use it frequently as a mask pack substitute before makeup application. Certainly, my makeup applies better when I use this compared to not using it. The built­in applicator clip also prevents me from losing it. It seems quite difficult to dramatically maintain elasticity with cosmetics rather than procedures. However, it doesn't seem to be an extremely major downside. To conserve pads, place three on your cheeks and one on your forehead. Take out another pad, cut it slightly, and apply it to your chin and nose. This way, you can save one more pad. Considering how often you use them, even saving one pad can be quite significant.

avis.titre: I apply two in the morning and...
avis.texte: I apply two in the morning and two in the evening. It's fantastic how well my makeup adheres, and my skin feels wonderfully hydrated the next morning. Among the Mediheal range, I think the collagen one is the absolute best! There's not really anything to complain about, but I wish they'd come out with a larger size. I've stocked up on refills, but I go through them so quickly! After removing my makeup in the evening, I always put on a pad for about 5 minutes, then apply a generous amount of moisturizer. When I wake up in the morning, my face has such a beautiful glow!

i'm in my early 50s with dry skin. after using these (now on my 2nd package) my face is more plump and firm. forehead lines and 11 lines have diminished, marionette lines have diminished, neck lines are diminished. sometimes i use them twice a day, sometimes only once. there's a difference when i skip using these completely. the container does leak a bit if packed on a trip and not transported upright - solve this by transferring a stack of the pads into a ziploc. they stay moist and take up less space in your luggage. use as the first step after ckeansing as it is watery and does take a minute or two to dry. one pad covers the face and neck/upper chest easily. follow with other serums of increasingly thicker viscosity before moisturizer and sunscreen. while using these i haven't had any negative interactions with other products or reactions on my skin so they should be fine for anyone with skin sensitivity.

As someone with dry, super sensitive skin, I've been loyal to these pads for years! While there's no dramatic effect, for those with sensitive skin, it's a relief that it doesn't cause any issues haha These pads work hard to maintain skin health without irritation, which is crucial for sensitive skin types.

It's so convenient to use generously. The pads are large, making them comfortable to leave on the skin. The texture of the pads can cause some irritation. Also, they seem to dry out quickly over time...

avis.titre: It's perfect for those busy or...
avis.texte: It's perfect for those busy or lazy days when you need a quick fix. I just place it on both cheeks and forehead for about 15 minutes before removing and applying my base makeup. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. There's not really anything to complain about. Some people mentioned the clips were uncomfortable, so I don't use them at all and just hold it with my hands, which can be a bit inconvenient. No special tips, just make sure to stick to the recommended time when removing it for the best results!

avis.titre: I love the comfort of being...
avis.texte: I love the comfort of being able to use each sheet while maintaining its moisture As it's a product I always use, I trust it more than I find faults with it

avis.titre: It adheres nicely to the face...
avis.texte: It adheres nicely to the face, providing a pleasant moisturizing effect. I didn't experience any particular irritation. I'm not sure how the collagen in this pad will benefit my skin. I didn't notice any significant improvements after using it.

As someone with super sensitive skin when it comes to pads, this is the most perfect one I've found. I'm currently on my 8th container (I have them placed in both my bedroom and bathroom). 1) Pad material (adhesion, no lint, flexibility) 2) Essence type (hydrating, non­sticky finish) 3) Functionality I often apply these while blow­drying my hair after a shower for about 10 minutes to replenish moisture, so adhesion and flexibility are crucial for me. They stick perfectly to my cheeks, including smile lines, and don't leave any lint when adjusting for a better fit. The essence is truly hydrating without feeling sticky, and with the added collagen benefits, it's just perfect... I use this as the first step in my skincare routine, and I don't even need to apply toner separately ­ it's that hydrating! There are no downsides. It's flawless! Even the tweezers and their holder are exceptionally well­designed.

avis.titre: This is the most hydrating and...
avis.texte: This is the most hydrating and firm pad among Mediheal's range! While it's great for soothing when applied to the cheeks, I was hoping for good moisturizing effects too. The formula isn't thin, but rather seems similar to Mediheal's collagen ampoule ­ it's much more substantial and elastic. Since it's not a sheet mask, it doesn't adhere perfectly to the cheeks and leaves some residue, which is a bit disappointing. However, it's still good for a light application.

avis.titre: I stuck these on my cheeks...
avis.texte: I stuck these on my cheeks while drying my hair on my morning commute, and my skin became plump and noticeably firmer than before. I heard there's another version that helps minimize pores, which I'm planning to try next. It's genuinely cooling, perfect for bringing down facial temperature in the morning. I'm absolutely thrilled with it! This product gets my highest recommendation. When I bought it, it came with a refill pack, so I can use it consistently for a long time. Being a pad, it did come off quite easily, which was a bit disappointing. Pro tip: When drying your hair, stick the collagen pad on your cheeks and wear a mask. It won't fly off in the wind and stays put on your cheeks!

avis.titre: The square shape of the toner...
avis.texte: The square shape of the toner pads makes them perfect for using as a face mask! Well, I didn't really notice any collagen effects, and it didn't seem to improve my blemishes either. It felt like it just provided hydration and nothing more.

I've tried various types of Mediheal pads ­ Madecassoside, Collagen, and the white exfoliating one. I'm on my second tub of the Collagen pads, which shows how much I love Mediheal. 1. The user experience is great. Honestly, when you hear 'collagen', you might expect something super sticky like pig skin, but these adhere comfortably with a slight powdery feel. While not as tacky as the Madecassoside version, they still have a pleasant, refreshing texture. 2. The formula is light and fresh. 3. My skin type? Let's just say if I eat pizza, I can expect three new blemishes the next day. It's just how it is! However, ever since I discovered the Mediheal Madecassoside and Collagen pads (100­count) during a buy­one­get­one­free event, I've been stocking up during every Olive Young sale. I've been repurposing the empty containers for months now to store lipsticks and other items, while keeping the full ones separate. Why? Because once you try them, you'll understand. You might think I'm trying to sell these, but I've genuinely seen a significant reduction in my blemishes. I've been using these two types (not the Cica line) whenever I feel like it or while working. Given the lightweight formula, it seems they could increase the amount of collagen essence. While it's great for mornings, I prefer something richer for nighttime use. Even when it dries completely, the skin underneath the pad doesn't feel dehydrated. After it dries, apply your favorite serum or ampoule. I recommend using an

These pads come with a little plastic tweezers that your can use to get out of the container and split to your face. They stick where you place them, so they're not slipping all over your face. My face always feels extra hydrated after using these.

Since these are collagen pads, you can feel your skin filling up with hydration and nourishment after use. The texture isn't too heavy, which is nice. Maybe it's just me, but the pads seem more saturated than the tea tree ones! Unlike the tea tree pads, these are made of a gentler material than gauze pads, so while the tea tree ones are more like an exfoliating toner, these are great for masking. They won't exfoliate, but when your skin is dehydrated, placing them on your cheeks feels cool and replenishing. Highly recommended for those with dry skin! Well, I would consider repurchasing, but they're not exceptionally amazing. Still, Mediheal products always deliver at least above­average results!

It's so moisturizing and the adherence is incredible ­ it never falls off once applied! I was worried about my makeup looking patchy due to dry weather and dead skin cells, but when I put this on before makeup, it clings to my skin like glue. I was amazed! While the collagen effects aren't dramatically visible right away, I did notice a subtle increase in my skin's radiance! It's perfect as a hydrating mask before base makeup. Just stick it on your cheeks after your morning cleanse and leave it on while you get ready. The generous amount means you can use it liberally without feeling wasteful, and opening the case just puts you in a good mood. It's that kind of pad.

avis.titre: This is my own purchase with...
avis.texte: This is my own purchase with my own money. I bought it at Olive Young. There were many other types of pads, but I chose this one as it seemed to offer the best value for money! The pads are thinner than pickled radish, and with 100 sheets, I can use them generously without worry. Despite being thin, they absorb well, so I never run out of essence. There were three types in the series, but I chose the collagen one to replenish my skin's glow. I pay close attention to the scent of skincare products, and this one had the most neutral and gentle fragrance, which is why I picked it. I love that there's no essence leakage from the container. I tend to toss my cosmetics around a bit roughly, but this doesn't leak and stays neat. The tweezers are also large and cool, which I like. The pads are quite thin, to the point where your skin might show through. If you prefer thicker pads, I wouldn't recommend these! If you think all pads are the same and cheaper is better, then go for it.

1. Purchase history: This is an item I always keep stocked up! 2. Features: It finishes with a moisturizing yet firm texture, truly giving that packed­with­nutrients feeling like you've just done a sheet mask!! It's great for daily use as a mask, and it's too precious to use as a toner due to its nourishing properties. I love that it has a larger surface area compared to other pads, and I definitely felt it soothing dry areas and blemishes. 3. Recommended skin types: I recommend it for combination dehydrated skin and dry skin! 4. Repurchase status: 4 times The price is a bit disappointing considering how much you use... You really need to keep an eye out for buy­one­get­one­free deals. The slightly sticky finish might feel heavy for some! It works even better if you apply it like a mask and finish with a moisturizing cream!

The fragrance of this product is absolutely delightful, and it's packed with a generous amount of toner, allowing for a deeply hydrating experience. What's more, the pads are noticeably softer compared to others, making them perfect for exfoliating toner application. There's not much to complain about, really. If anything, it might be a bit too hydrating for those with extremely oily skin. For best results, I recommend flipping the container upside down before opening it. This helps ensure the toner is evenly distributed on all the pads.

I was really satisfied with how it absorbs into the skin, providing hydration without feeling sticky. The pads are generously soaked in essence, so one sheet was enough to cover my entire face. It also has a cooling effect, which definitely helped soothe my skin. Even with my super sensitive skin, I could use it comfortably without any blemishes. Especially when used after morning cleansing, it seemed to make my makeup apply better. The pads felt slightly small, so I needed to use about two sheets to cover my entire face satisfactorily. Also, the container opening was a bit narrow, making it somewhat inconvenient to take out the pads. It would have been more hygienic if tweezers were included. Keeping it in the refrigerator doubled the cooling effect, which was great for reducing morning puffiness. Leaving it on my cheeks and forehead for about 5 minutes like a mask made my skin feel instantly soothed.

I bought this during last year's sale and still haven't finished it ­ that's how generous the quantity is! I think I've repurchased it several times. The pads are thin and lightweight, which I love. When I use them, my skin gets that Inner Glow, and I don't even need to do a separate skincare routine. Sometimes the pads are so thin they can tear. Occasionally, if I leave them on for too long, they fall off on their own... strange?

These pads have become a holy grail in my skincare routine! I have rosacea and combination skin, so my skin can get really dry at times. Ever since I started using these, they've helped retain moisture and leave my skin feeling noticeably more plump. I also have sensitive skin, and thankfully, I haven't experienced any irritation!

Fantastic! Makes your skin as soft as a baby's bottom. The pads themselves are gentle, causing less irritation. None. If anything needs changing, it's the tea tree pads. These pads feel better than the tea tree ones ­ they should update the material for those. Absolutely amazing as a skin pack. Don't use it as an exfoliating toner pad ­ it's a must to use it as a skin pack instead.

avis.titre: I love how it improves my skin...
avis.texte: I love how it improves my skin texture and provides excellent hydration. It's effective for moisturizing, and the hydration lasts without evaporating quickly. Even with my sensitive skin, I used it without any blemishes or itching. The amount of serum is too little. When using it as a mask, there's not enough serum, and the pad is extremely thin. The serum doesn't stay on the pad long enough, which is really disappointing. It's great to use as a mask. It helps reduce heat in the skin and works well for hydration.

I've had a great experience using the Hwahae pads. They make my skin feel firm and elastic, and they're actually so sticky they cling to your fingers a bit. I'd recommend these for dry or combination skin types, but they might not be suitable for oily skin. The firming effect on the skin is only temporary. Of course, if you use it consistently for a very long time, your skin might change, but I don't think there's a compelling reason to use this product exclusively for an extended period. When I use it for night care, my skin becomes excessively oily the next day (combination dehydrated skin), so I prefer to use it as part of my Hwahae routine.

Instantly fills skin with deep hydration when applied! Generous amount of product and plenty of ampoule Hygienic dispenser with tweezers at the top for easy removal Highly recommended for dry skin! No deep dryness or tightness even when used alone without other skincare Didn't cause any blemishes despite my sensitive skin Leaked even when the lid was tightly closed The tweezers at the top were loose and often fell onto the pads
The more I use these pads, the glowier my skin looks. Lately, I've been receiving compliments on my skin when I apply my makeup, and I know this product is one of the reasons. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: I felt like I needed to do...
avis.texte: I felt like I needed to do something for skin elasticity, so I decided to buy this to use as a light toner pad. I'm not sure if collagen just works well for me, but after using these toner pads, my skin became incredibly smooth. When you use it, you can feel the hydration filling from deep within, so I really, really recommend it for those with dry skin. The pads themselves are thin and large, making them great for masking, and there's absolutely no irritation from the pads. The tweezers are difficult to use, so I just pick up the pads with my fingers. The pads are made of a stretchy material, so you can stretch them to fit the shape of your face or target specific areas you want to treat.

avis.titre: This review is after using up...
avis.texte: This review is after using up a refill purchase. Being a collagen pad, it's quite agreeable without any dryness or such issues. It's thinner than tea tree pads but thicker than watermide pads. Since my face tends to get hot, I kept them in the fridge. As someone who loves sheet masks, I really enjoyed these. They're packed with hydration and do a great job of refining skin texture. The disappointing aspect is the tweezers. Mediheal's pad tweezers are the worst. After washing my hair, I wipe my face with a pad, then fold it and stick it on my nose. I also put two pads on my forehead. When I dry my hair with these on, it really helps combat deep dryness in the skin.
It's so refreshing and clean, making it a pleasure to use. This Hwahae favorite is almost too good to use up! While my skin feels firmer after application, the effect only lasts right after use.

The pad material is soft, complementing the essence formula perfectly. It's especially great to use before applying makeup. This product is a Hwahae favorite. I recommend it even for those with sensitive skin, as it has low friction when used for tapping motions. The included tweezers aren't ideal for picking up one pad at a time. It's also excellent for boosting hydration before applying makeup.
They sre just ok. I like the tweezer in it but tbe formula us only so so gor me. I prefer the carrot face pads i get from yesstyle
They sre just ok. I like the tweezer in it but tbe formula us only so so gor me. I prefer the carrot face pads i get from yesstyle
This product is so good at keeping my skin hydrated, definitely worth it. Its very soothing on the skin and has not broken me out. Already on my 3rd one !

Usually I have issue of my makeup separating due to patch of dry skins. Ever since I started leaving it on before starting my makeup, my make up no longer separate in patches. The pads add so much hydration back to my skin. Definitely important product for skin prep!!

avis.titre: It's pricey, but I apply it...
avis.texte: It's pricey, but I apply it right after washing my face and before drying my hair. This way, I prevent my skin from drying out! Now that I'm in my thirties, I'm really focusing on skincare, and collagen is a must. The absorption and hydration are great, so on days when I'm not using a mask, I use this as a substitute. It's almost empty, so I'll have to buy another one soon! How can I write about drawbacks when there aren't any? I only review products I've tried and liked.

I actually purchased this product. The texture is just right ­ not too heavy or too light. Plus, the generous amount makes it great for regular use. There was a slightly sticky feeling. When I used it with an exfoliating toner in the morning, the stickiness was quite unpleasant.
Ive been trying these pads for about a week now, and I love how my skin feels after using them. Plump, soft, and hydrated! Love Mediheal products. So glad they're now carried at Ulta!

Perfect for those times when you're too lazy for a full face mask or find them a bit pricey! It's exactly what I've been looking for to finish off my night routine, especially around the eyes and smile lines. I'm thrilled it even contains collagen ­ I'm using it with complete satisfaction! If I had to nitpick, the patches are quite large when split into four from two. It would be fantastic if they could be designed to split into four pieces each. That would be super appealing for those who want to target specific areas. Works great when divided and applied to the eye area, smile lines, and cheekbones.

I'm absolutely thrilled with these collagen patches! They're generously sized, so you can use them not just for the eye area, but also cut them to fit other parts of your face. It's like having a mini mask ­ so versatile! The subtle, pleasant fragrance makes the whole skincare experience even more enjoyable. They leave my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed ­ I'm completely satisfied! I used these with complete satisfaction, no complaints at all! I confidently recommend them to everyone! These collagen patches are especially great to use after a shower while you're drying your hair! Skin protection from hot air ­ They shield your face from the direct heat of the hairdryer. Time­saving ­ You can do your skincare while drying your hair! More effective absorption ­ The warm steam after showering seems to help the skin absorb the product better. I highly recommend this as a simple yet effective routine!

Great for masking after cleansing if you have dry skin! Not ideal for doctor's office­style masking. Not sure if it's just me, but when I put it on my forehead, my eyes feel a bit sensitive. It dries out quickly after 10­15 minutes. While it's thin and adheres well, I don't think I can use it while blow­drying my hair as it would dry out too fast.

I'm 55yrs old with wrinkles creeping in around my mouth. I buy expensive products for my face & nothing works. Bought this product per my daughter's recommendation and immediately saw improvement. The deep lines appear reduced, and my face has a more youthful glow.

It's wonderfully moisturizing! I often sit cross­legged, which makes the skin around my ankles dry and cracked. I applied some of the leftover product there, and it made my skin so soft! When I leave it on for about 5 minutes before bed, my face feels hot in the morning. Because of this, I finish with a light exfoliating toner in the morning. Oh, and it's quite difficult to open the package for the first time!

The 'Real Collagen Filling Pad' truly lives up to its name! When I use it, I can feel the collagen being absorbed deep into my skin. Compared to other masks, it feels so much smoother and more slippery! The fragrance is lovely too! It might be a bit challenging to use for removing dead skin cells, and the tweezers that come with it are difficult to secure to the container. There's plenty of ampoule inside, so after masking, I recommend using the remaining ampoule with an exfoliating toner for best results!

avis.titre: I have skin that's not prone...
avis.texte: I have skin that's not prone to blemishes, but with lots of pores on my T­zone and nose. In my early 20s, I had a major skin flare­up, so I stuck to tea tree pads. But since then, I rarely get blemishes, and now in my 30s, I thought maybe I should start caring for wrinkles too, so I bought this. To be honest, I didn't expect much, but I totally recommend it! I'm not sure about its effects on wrinkles or plumping (honestly, for wrinkles and firmness, I think getting treatments at a dermatologist is the way to go). Instead, after cleansing, I place a pad on each side of my T­zone for 5­10 minutes, and when I remove them, my pores have visibly shrunk! I've tried a wide variety of toner pads, including Mediheal tea tree pads, and always used them similarly on my T­zone after cleansing, but I've never seen such a dramatic effect on pores before! I'm almost done with my first jar... planning to buy more with the 1+1 deal. I wonder if this is the volume plumping effect mentioned in the ad? If the pore reduction is due to that, then it's definitely not ineffective. I highly recommend it! There wasn't really anything bad. If I had to say something, it would be nice if they came out with a separate collagen line focused on this pink collagen product. Leave it on your T­zone for 5 minutes!

My experience with collagen ampoule pads over the past 6 months :heartpulse: I've been consistently using collagen ampoule pads for the last 6 months, going through 3 containers. This product is an easy way to supply your skin with the collagen it needs, conveniently packaged as toner pads for daily use. It's been incredibly helpful for me, as I used to struggle with dull skin lacking elasticity. Product features and usage These collagen ampoule pads are a type of skincare pad soaked in collagen ampoule, allowing you to massage it directly onto your skin. They're designed to minimize unnecessary irritation and simplify your skincare routine, making them perfect for busy mornings or evenings. One side of the pad is smooth, while the other has texture, allowing you to gently exfoliate dead skin cells and refine your skin texture as you use it. Effective hydration and elasticity The most significant benefits I've noticed are improved skin hydration and elasticity. My skin felt instantly moisturized after use, and over time, I could feel it becoming healthier. This hydrating effect was crucial for me, as I often struggled with dry, lackluster skin. Even when used in the morning, my skin stayed moisturized throughout the day. Thanks to the collagen content, I also saw improvements in my skin's elasticity. I had been noticing sagging and loss of firmness, but after using these pads, my skin felt more supple and bouncy. It's satisfying to see my skin becoming healthier and more resi

avis.titre: It's been ages since I've used...

avis.titre: I found myself reaching for it...

avis.titre: I loved how much essence was...
avis.texte: I loved how much essence was in it. I used it morning and night, and I definitely got a lot of compliments on how my skin improved. After applying, it felt a bit oily? Or how should I say it? Anyway, I didn't really get that fresh, matte feeling. I usually leave toner pads on until they dry when I use them. Using it this way allows the essence soaked in the pad to absorb into the skin, which is great!

First of all, it's so refreshing! I've been using it consistently because it's supposed to help with wrinkles and facial sagging. It's absolutely wonderful to use before applying makeup. I'm using it comfortably without any issues. Sometimes my face feels hot and slightly tingly. When my skin is irritated, I think other soothing pads might be better. It also evens out skin texture nicely and is great for easy use before makeup application.

avis.titre: I loved that it's a gauze­type...
avis.texte: I loved that it's a gauze­type mask soaked generously in essence! It was great for combating deep dryness when I dried my face after removing the mask. Talk about getting your money's worth! While it provided ample hydration, I couldn't really notice any other significant benefits, unfortunately.

First off, the scent is absolutely divine! I love how it's packed with what seems like toner. It's fantastic for prepping your skin before makeup, creating the perfect canvas for flawless application. While the collagen effects weren't dramatically visible, I'm sure it's better than not using it at all. I've been using it regularly for healthier skin! Those with dry skin might find it a bit lacking. While it does provide some hydration, it absorbs rather quickly and lightly. You might want to follow up with a richer moisturizer for better results.
It's gentle and moisturizing. I love that it's thin and doesn't easily come off. The only downside is that it's a bit on the pricey side...

avis.titre: I bought this for my parents...
avis.texte: I bought this for my parents after hearing it's effective for skin elasticity and wrinkle improvement. They're loving it and using it well! I tried it too, and it seems to do a great job at refining skin texture. It's really impressive! There's nothing particularly bad to mention! Everything about it is fantastic. The entire Mediheal toner pad line seems to be excellent.

Oh wow, this is absolutely amazing for skin soothing and firmness. I can't recommend it enough! I'm saving that last point in case Mediheal comes out with something even better next time~! Hmm, the design is okay, but the initial opening and peeling can be a bit tricky. That's the only issue. Here's a pro tip: First, cleanse thoroughly with a foam cleanser. Then apply this mask for about 15 minutes. After removing it, follow up with your regular cream. The results are simply unbelievable!

The adhesion is absolutely fantastic and the hydration is top­notch! The pads are so soft that even those with super sensitive skin could probably use them. It's great to put them on while drying your hair, and there's plenty of product so you can use them generously. They're perfect for just replenishing moisture. The tweezers don't grip well, and it seems like the lid doesn't close properly.

avis.titre: I bought this for my mom and...

The clips come off too easily... Even when I place them on top, they keep falling off, so I have to keep picking them up and putting them back.

It's wonderfully hydrating. After wiping once and letting it absorb, then wiping again with the other side, the pad dries out perfectly. It dries a bit too quickly if you're trying to dry your hair while masking, which is slightly disappointing. Also, when you close the lid tightly, it can be a bit challenging for those with less strength to open.

I've only tried the hydrating and spot treatment pads before, but since they were out of stock, I bought the collagen ones. There's a slight slippery feeling, but I liked that when applied to the skin, there was no slipperiness or stickiness. I didn't notice any significant improvement in skin elasticity. Although there's a tweezer included, it doesn't pick up one sheet at a time, so I end up having to peel them off with my fingers.
I used this like 3 times and my pores were the smallest and cleanest they have EVER been.Obsessd with this entire brand.

Just a tip: each pad is so saturated with essence that after using it, you can squeeze out plenty of toner. Keep that in mind for maximum product use!

It's great for quick use because the sheet is soft and keeps skin hydrated So far, I haven't really found anything to complain about

Works great for most skin types. Definitely gives glass skin when you use this with a moisturizer. It makes your skin very glowy and healthy looking
Had boughten because had a good deal and gifted it to my mom and she absolutely uses it every single day!

I've used Mediheal toner pads ­ both the Collagen Filling Pad and the Vita Mide Spot Pad. Last year: Vita Mide Spot Pad (for blemishes, evening skin tone, brightening) Currently: Collagen Elasticity Filling Pad (for firmness and bounce) Vita Mide Spot Pad: I used this product early last year. Mediheel is quite famous, and the reviews were great, so I gave it a try. I saw significant improvement in my complexion. Before using this product, my skin was really dull and lifeless. About 3 weeks after I started using it, a friend suddenly asked me why I looked human again! Since this was the only new product I was using, I realized it must really be effective. While it claims to have brightening effects, I didn't notice any major changes in that area. With consistent use, it definitely evens out skin tone, and though the brightening effect wasn't dramatic, there was a noticeable improvement. Collagen Filling Pad: I bought this product at Olive Young about 3 weeks ago. I wanted to get the Vita Mide again, but it was out of stock, so I settled for this one. This product is genuinely amazing. I've been using it for almost 2­3 weeks, and my skin feels so much firmer. Previously, no matter how good my skincare routine was, I never felt like it was nourishing my skin deeply. But this Collagen Filling Pad seems to do just that. It's like it's building elasticity from deep within the skin. It's supposed to help with wrinkles too, but I haven't seen that effect yet. What I can say for sure

­ Skin type: Combination (Closer to oily in summer and dry in winter) As someone with combination skin that's particularly affected by seasons, I have to change my skincare routine every time the seasons change. It's such a hassle! Recently, with winter setting in, my skin has been feeling dry from the surface to deep within. So, I tried these collagen pads, and they're absolutely amazing! The pads themselves are quite thick but incredibly soft! They're soaked in essence ­ I've never seen pads with this much essence before. That's the first win right there. Maybe it's because of the collagen, but my skin definitely feels firmer and more elastic? That's why they're great to use before applying makeup as a pre­makeup treatment for The Hwahae Testers' approval. On important days, I stick these collagen pads on my cheeks and forehead for about 5 minutes, then gently smooth out my skin texture ­ it's simply flawless... To be honest, the lack of flaws is this product's only flaw, but if I had to pick something, the case lid and tweezers were a bit inconvenient. When opening and closing the case lid, it doesn't close well, so I worry about the essence drying out. Even when I use force to close it tightly, I'm not sure if it's properly sealed. If they could improve it with more user­friendly tweezers, I think this toner pad would be unbeatable. The rose scent is absolutely lovely. The pads are a good size and square­shaped, so they're easy to apply anywhere. They're incredibly hydrating, with 100 sheets soaked in a full bottle of essence. The essence is well­absorbed into the pads without excess pooling outside. Despite being called 'Collagen Filling Pads', I haven't noticed any collagen­boosting effects yet.

avis.titre: I'm on my second bottle and my...

If you want to use it before makeup, it's best suited for dry or combination dehydrated skin types. As someone with combination dehydrated skin, I found it quite moisturizing, but perhaps a bit too hydrating. Because of this, it wasn't ideal for use under makeup. I strongly recommend this for your nighttime skincare routine. However, it's absolutely not suitable for oily skin types!
Love this product! My face feels and looks amazing! My husband also swears by it! He uses it on his forehead every morning to calm his deep sleep wrinkles!

It's great to use as a mask by leaving it on the skin for 10 minutes, then applying serum and moisturizer! Keeping it in the refrigerator before use provides a soothing effect!

I love using thos product it cleared my skin #1 i have very dry sensitive skin and this has helped a ton I do this every night one on each cheek sometimes before my makeup for the day! Not greasy either its the perfect hydration to your skincare!
